sentences.text:
Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition NOs.6132, 6140 and 6152 Of 2020
Order:

These criminal petitions are filed by the petitioners/Accused under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code (for short "Cr.P.C.") to quash the proceedings in Crime No.168 of 2020 pending on the file of Pedakurapadu Police Station, Guntur District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 270, 273, 188, 420 IPC and Sections 56, 57(i), 63 of FSS Act (Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006); Crime No.400 of 2020 pending on the file of V.Sataram Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of FSS Act (Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006); Crime No.478 of 2020 pending on the file of Salur Town Police Station, Vizianagaram District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 270 and 273 IPC.

entities.text: FSS Act (Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006)
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Salur Town Police Station, Vizianagaram District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh submit that the issues involved in these petitions are squarely covered by the order of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.

In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh, these Criminal Petitions also stand allowed in terms of the said order.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.
The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

__________________________________________ JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY Date: 29.12.2020 AKN THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE M.SATYANARAYANA MURTHY CRIMINAL PETITION NOs. 6132, 6140 and 6152 OF 2020 Date: 29.12.2020 AKN Chejerla Narayana, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 29 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198247592/
